title: CrewForm
x-status: PROVISIONAL: CrewForm is not one of Spec 1's seven contracts. Spec 2 (crew data foundation): the post-EVA form, meals and short crew notes as stored, replayable records in the habitat service. Glucose is a Reading (indicator glucose), not a form. Replay event type: form. Needs team agreement before it is frozen (add-only).
